TARGET_DOMAIN.description: Apex domain whose leaked credentials will be sprayed against assets in the Faraday workspace, e.g. 'faradaysec.com'.

TARGET_SUBDOMAIN.description: Narrow the credential source to a specific subdomain (LIKE wildcards allowed for the ClickHouse backend, e.g. '%.corp.faradaysec.com').

PROTOCOLS.description: Protocols to try. Default: ssh, http, https, ftp, smb, smtp, imap, pop3. Comma-separated in the WebUI Run form.

LIMIT.description: Cap the number of leaked credentials fetched from the source before spraying. Default: unlimited (source-dependent).

BAGRE_SOURCE.description: Leak-source backend. Valid: 'intelx' (Intelligence X public API), 'intelx_leaks' (IntelX Leaks-only bucket subset), 'clickhouse' (on-prem leak-DB). Default 'intelx'.

INTELX_API_KEY.description: Intelligence X API key. Normally pre-configured on the dispatcher as a varenv — leave blank in the Run form to use the agent-side value.

INTELX_BASE_URL.description: Intelligence X API base URL. Default 'https://free.intelx.io' (free tier). Paid tenants set 'https://2.intelx.io'.

INTELX_MAX_FILES.description: Cap on files pulled per bucket. Default 100.

CLICKHOUSE_HOST.description: ClickHouse host for the on-prem leak-DB backend (BAGRE_SOURCE=clickhouse). Bare hostname or IP — no scheme. Ignored when BAGRE_SOURCE is intelx / intelx_leaks.

CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE.description: ClickHouse database name for the leak tables.

CLICKHOUSE_USER.description: ClickHouse username. Normally pre-configured on the dispatcher as a varenv.

CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD.description: ClickHouse password. Normally pre-configured on the dispatcher as a varenv.

FARADAY_URL.description: Faraday server base URL used to enumerate spray targets from the workspace (e.g. 'https://faraday.example.com').

FARADAY_USER.description: Faraday admin username. Normally pre-configured on the dispatcher as a varenv.

FARADAY_PASSWORD.description: Faraday admin password. Normally pre-configured on the dispatcher as a varenv.

FARADAY_WORKSPACE.description: Faraday workspace name to enumerate targets from (hosts, services, credentials).

BAGRE_PASSWORD_SPRAY_MAX_ATTEMPTS_PER_US.description: Per-user lockout guardrail. Default 3. Set lower (e.g. 2) for accounts with tight lockout policies.

BAGRE_PASSWORD_SPRAY_DELAY_MS.description: Delay between individual authentication attempts (ms). Default 1000. Increase to blend into normal auth traffic.

BAGRE_PASSWORD_SPRAY_MAX_TOTAL_ATTEMPTS.description: Absolute cap on authentication attempts per run. Default 1000 — protects against runaway sprays if the leak set is huge.

BAGRE_PASSWORD_SPRAY_CONCURRENCY.description: Number of concurrent workers. Default 5. Higher values raise IDS/lockout risk.

BAGRE_PASSWORD_SPRAY_EXCLUDE_USERS.description: Comma-separated usernames to skip entirely. Default 'admin,administrator,root' — the accounts most likely to trigger security alerts on failed auth.

BAGRE_PASSWORD_SPRAY_DRY_RUN.description: Set 'true' to log every planned auth attempt without actually authenticating. Use for a safety check before the first live run. Default 'false'.

name: bagre_spray
title: Bagre Password Spray
description: Validates leaked credentials from Bagre by spraying them against assets and services discovered in the Faraday workspace. Pulls credentials from the configured source (IntelX default — needs INTELX_API_KEY), enumerates targets via the Faraday REST API (FARADAY_URL / USER / PASSWORD / WORKSPACE), and authenticates over ssh/http/https/ftp/smb/smtp/imap/pop3. Lockout guardrails are on by default (max 3 attempts per user, 1000 total per run, 1s inter-attempt delay, excludes admin/administrator/root). Set BAGRE_PASSWORD_SPRAY_DRY_RUN=true to log planned attempts without authenticating. Run only against authorised targets.
